proposal.summary: Integer overflow in Exynos Mobile Processor 980 and 2100 can corrupt a buffer index and prevent execution of requested services when triggered by a crafted application.
proposal.cwe_quote: An integer overflow at a buffer index

A.quote: can prevent the execution of requested services

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request affected firmware/software version details and a vendor-provided patch/mitigation; obtain reproduction steps and exploitability information to assign a CVE and determine impact scope.

evidence_quotes.quote: An integer overflow at a buffer index
can prevent the execution of requested services via a crafted application.
